description: UX A2: chat. 2 windowed F2F 0.32 clients (alice = admin, bob) + protocol clients (carol, dev). Alice opens the chat with T (the engine's chat binding), types, Enter: bob gets ChatLine with sender/role admin/time; bob opens it with Enter and answers: alice hears fx_chat and sees the HUD feed. Carol floods 12 lines: 5..6 accepted, Notice 8 (code 20), bob sees exactly the accepted ones. Late joiner dev gets ChatHistory with the whole conversation in order and the join line goes out; /help for a player lists no admin commands. Alice's overlay window (14 lines) scrolls back by 5 with ^. Consistency 0.
